// Run when one dies: counts it for the quest BanditQuest (stage 1). Generated by build_regions.py
01	Get.Value	ATTRIBUTE	BanditQuest	Variable.1$
02	>Conditional	$Variable.1=1	13
03	Get.Value	ATTRIBUTE	BanditsSlain	Variable.2$
04	>Conditional	$Variable.2<5	13
05	Update.Attribute	BanditsSlain	+1
06	Get.Value	CALCULATION	$Variable.2+1	Variable.2$
07	>Conditional	$Variable.2<5	10
08	Display.Message	Yellow	Bandits slain for Captain Hale: $Variable.2 of 5.
09	End
10	Quest.Note.Done	BanditQuest	Bandits rob travellers on the Redrock road and in the hills: slay five.
11	Quest.Note	BanditQuest	Report to Captain Hale in Highwatch.
12	Display.Message	Yellow	Five bandits! Report to Captain Hale in Highwatch.
13	End
